_doc: Thresholds for the nightly long run (scripts/nightly-run.mjs, workflow nightly-run.yml, issue #574). The run plays a headless Fellowship with mock local minds (no paid API, no Ollama) and fails when one is crossed; the failure opens or updates the issue 'Nightly agent run failed'. Change a number here in the same PR that moves the behaviour it guards. idle is judged by maxIdleGameHours, not a count (the mock minds only wait, so short idles are expected); reflex-votes, no-aim and repeated-narration are properties of the mocks and are not limited.
